It splits work into a versioned static layer under static/ and a dynamic router that loads fragments from disk instead of improvising from memory. Every invocation starts by reading manifest.yaml and always_load files stance.md and workflow.md, then identifies task mode such as draft, audit, revise, triage-only, or appeal-like, decision type including minor or major revision, and user language for optional Chinese alignment blocks. The ten-step workflow extracts editor instructions and reviewer comments with stable IDs, classifies each item, builds a strategy summary, drafts point-by-point responses from preserved comments, maps claimed changes to manuscript locations or explicit placeholders, flags missing author input as AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED, and returns a package with readiness state. Deep references under references/ load on demand for comment taxonomy, tone, difficult cases, and QA. The skill never invents experiments, citations, line numbers, figure panels, or manuscript changes, and routes appea.
highlights: Router loads manifest.yaml plus static/core stance.md and workflow.md on every invocation.
Supports draft, audit, revise, triage-only, and appeal-like modes with decision-type routing.
Ten-step workflow preserves reviewer comment IDs and maps each response to manuscript locations.
